rules.name: tenant-oidc-exchange
rules.basis: Existing OIDC verification, linking/JIT and account activation checks govern token exchange; no automatic activation is authorized by this declaration.

rules.name: tenant-password-exchange
rules.basis: Password verification, account status and durable throttling precede session issuance; this is a credential exchange, not an anonymous data read.

rules.name: tenant-refresh-token
rules.basis: Existing refresh credential verification and rotation govern session renewal, without requiring a still-valid bearer access token.

rules.name: tenant-signed-download-capability
rules.basis: NOT PUBLIC: handler verifies the signed download capability before encrypted storage read; unavailable connected bank keys remain a refusal.

rules.name: tenant-sso-internal-key
rules.basis: NOT PUBLIC: handler requires a configured SSO_INTERNAL_KEY and constant-time header comparison before resolving server-to-server OIDC client configuration. Unconfigured returns 404; missing/invalid internal key returns 401.

rules.name: tenant-taxonomy-authenticated
rules.basis: The separately authorized taxonomy authentication change is landed. These exact static-vocabulary GETs require the existing Tenant authentication chain, with no additional role or module-scope gate.

rules.name: unsupported-case-financial-entity-rejection
rules.basis: Explicit rejection-only fallback: valid identifiers always receive 404 without session, storage or financial operations. This declares no resource access.
